-- test: scheduled tasks --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} scheduledtasks
-- expect:regex --
TYPE\s+TARGET\s+SCHEDULE\s+NEXT\s+LAST\s+STATUS
-- expect:regex --
cron\s+TestScheduledTasks\.cronTask\s+cron\(0 \* \* \* \* \*\)
-- expect:regex --
fixedDelay\s+TestScheduledTasks\.fixedDelayTask\s+fixedDelay=5m
-- expect:regex --
fixedRate\s+TestScheduledTasks\.fixedRateTask\s+fixedRate=30m
-- expect --
SUCCESS
-- expect:regex --
in \d+
-- expect:regex --
\d+m?s ago


-- test: scheduled tasks wide shows full targets --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} scheduledtasks -o wide
-- expect:regex --
fixedDelay\s+com\.example\.testapp\.TestScheduledTasks\.fixedDelayTask


-- test: scheduled-tasks alias --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} scheduled-tasks
-- expect:regex --
TYPE\s+TARGET
